_doc: THE FORMULA LIBRARY (Julian, 2026-07-25). The product is not the rulebook — it is this. One PROVEN prompt shape per dramatic form, each derived from real fires and each tagged so it is never applied to material it was not proven on. A form with status 'missing' has NO exemplar: the writer is told plainly it is DISCOVERING one, and must not borrow a shape proven on different material. Nothing here is ever fabricated — a formula earns 'proven' only when a real take was approved under it, and provenBy names the evidence.

physical_comedy.label: physical comedy / action chain
physical_comedy.appliesTo: a physical cause-and-consequence spine: crashes, chases, collisions, gag beats where the comedy is in weight, momentum and mistimed recovery
physical_comedy.provenBy: eleven live A/B fires, 2026-07-25; Julian's verdict on the winner: "it's perfect"
physical_comedy.notes: Word spend, not word count: ~720 words is correct here because every sentence buys physics. Do not read the length as a target for lighter material.

quiet_emotion.label: quiet emotion / interior beat
quiet_emotion.appliesTo: a held, internal moment: realisation, grief, wonder turning inward, a decision made without movement
quiet_emotion.notes: Physical-comedy spend is actively WRONG here — a beat whose whole point is stillness cannot be written as a chain of impacts.

two_hander_dialogue.label: two-character dialogue exchange
two_hander_dialogue.appliesTo: two characters talking, where the shot's job is the exchange itself — timing, listening, the beat between lines
two_hander_dialogue.notes: The audio track carries the words; the open question this form must answer is what the picture does while it does.

tension_reveal.label: tension / reveal
tension_reveal.appliesTo: withheld information becoming visible: the approach, the turn, the thing seen

fast_action.label: fast action, non-comic
fast_action.appliesTo: urgency played straight — a rescue, a storm, a chase with stakes rather than gags
fast_action.notes: Adjacent to physical_comedy but NOT the same: the recovery-into-pride beat that ends a comedy chain is wrong here.

wonder_establishing.label: wonder / establishing
wonder_establishing.appliesTo: the world presented for its own sake: scale, light, arrival somewhere

transition.label: transition ending in movement
transition.appliesTo: a shot whose job is to carry the audience into the next place or time, ending in motion rather than settling
transition.notes: A closing hold is a failure of this form by definition.
